sampling.method: shared seeded random held-out window order across four poles; stop each pole after 16 distinct strong windows; one uniform activation per sampled window
sampling.gpu_scheduling: normal-priority FIFO turn per model forward, with the project batch-memory slot

notes: Budgeted joint coverage sampling: four poles share the seeded random held-out window order of L34/N4070-, with each pole using its own contribution-id seed for uniform per-window selection. The 0.30 threshold and first-64-token exclusion match graph.coverage.draw; each pole stops after at least 16 distinct strong windows instead of oversampling 48. The final batch can contain extra qualifying windows; its batch size is recorded in methods.sampling. No label-based sample selection. Activations are the original float16 readings; the PR reports an additional bfloat16 check of these fixed positions. Marks judge the registered label without broadening it. Explicit per-unit averages (weight per animal, branch points per neuron, goals per match, area per home) count as per-member amounts rather than aggregate totals. Singular card/bath allocations count as one per recipient/room. Bare each without a specified amount does not count. The two code excerpts do not explicitly state a per-member amount in the visible context and are marked false.
